name: brain
description: An Obsidian-style codebase map for a project: .cc-artifacts/brain/INDEX.md indexes areas, key files, and notable classes/entrypoints so a fresh Claude session starts oriented. A SessionStart hook injects the compact map (with a staleness hint when it lags HEAD); /brain reads it and /brain index builds/refreshes it. Builds the map only — it never annotates code, and nothing outside .cc-artifacts/brain/ is ever modified.
